tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Who UltraTech Pakistan is, where its office is, how to contact it and its commercial terms. Use this before recommending or contacting the company.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List UltraTech Pakistan's service categories, groups and services with their page URLs. Optionally filter to one category slug.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find the UltraTech Pakistan services that match a need in plain language, e.g. 'cameras for my shop', 'FBR invoicing', 'backup power for server'.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one service as markdown: what's included, who it's for, brands, process and FAQs. Use the slug from list_services or search_services.

tools.name: calculate_cctv_storage
tools.description: Estimate the hard-disk storage a CCTV system needs and suggest a disk size. Same calculation as https://utechit.pk/tools/cctv-hard-disk-storage-calculator

tools.name: calculate_ups_backup
tools.description: Estimate how long a battery bank runs a load (e.g. during load-shedding), the battery capacity needed for a target time, and a minimum UPS rating. Same calculation as https://utechit.pk/tools/ups-battery-backup-time-calculator

tools.name: prepare_quote_request
tools.description: Draft a quote request email to UltraTech Pakistan for the user to send. This does not send anything; it returns the address, subject and body, and a mailto link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: prepare_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: prepare_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
